content.6.5.3 Reinterventions: This section discusses the frequency and impact of reinterventions in patients after endovascular or open repair of thoracic aortic aneurysms.
content.6.5.3.1 Left Subclavian Artery Managemen: It covers the management strategies and outcomes related to left subclavian artery coverage during thoracic endovascular aortic repair, highlighting impacts on neurological complications and survival.
content.6.5.3.4 Celiac Artery Management: Analyzes outcomes of celiac artery coverage during endovascular and open repair, pointing to various study results.
content.6.5.3.5 Ruptured Descending TAA: Focuses on surgical versus endovascular repair of ruptured thoracic aortic aneurysms, exploring different studies and their outcomes.
content.6.5.3.6 Access Issues for TEVAR in Desce: Discusses procedural access challenges for thoracic endovascular aortic repair, assessing different methods and their effectiveness.
content.6.5.4 Size Thresholds for Open Surgical: Reviews recommended size thresholds for surgical intervention in thoracic aortic aneurysm cases, based on various studies.
content.6.5.4.2 Open Versus Endovascular Repair: Explores survival and outcomes post endovascular and open repair, presenting findings from several studies.
